initial_fixed_crop.method: PyMuPDF text clip (45,65,width-45,height-55); nonwhitespace Unicode characters

accepted_page_element_exclusion.method: PyMuPDF dict lines; remove header y0<55pt, footer text containing / ReadFlow below690pt and the matching printed-page label at x0>400pt,y0>690pt; count nonwhitespace Unicode characters of remaining spans. Do not crop tall body lines at foot.
accepted_page_element_exclusion.scope: Non-whitespace chars only; text_letters/math_chars font estimates not independently rederived.

interpretation: Initial crop omitted tall body lines. The accepted rule excludes observed headers/footers by their page element identity and reproduces 1663/1663 counts. Matching text extraction does not imply a page has no visual overlap.
